name: Feedback Recording & Storage
description: Records insights/findings with unique feedback_ids and metadata, stores them in JSONL files, and provides async read/write APIs for feedback data. Findings are recorded at surfacing time with a minted feedback_id (fb-* prefix). Users can later rate findings (helpful, already_knew, wrong, irrelevant). All records are frozen Pydantic v2 models persisted to .stigmergy/findings.jsonl and .stigmergy/feedback.jsonl with in-memory dict indexes for O(1) lookups. Write serialization via asyncio.Lock. Defensive JSONL parsing skips blank/malformed lines with warnings. Re-rating is supported with append-only semantics (latest rating wins). Rating-to-calibration mapping is NOT in this component — it lives in attention/calibration.py.

types.name: Rating
types.description: Literal rating type for findings. Implemented as Literal['helpful', 'already_knew', 'wrong', 'irrelevant'] in Python (not an Enum class). 'helpful' = positive signal, 'already_knew' = mild positive (correct but low novelty), 'wrong' = negative signal, 'irrelevant' = negative signal.

functions.name: mint_feedback_id
functions.description: Generate a unique feedback_id string with the 'fb-' prefix. Uses a combination of timestamp and random bytes to ensure uniqueness. This is a standalone synchronous utility function in primitives/feedback.py. Intended to be called at finding-surfacing time.
postconditions: Returned string matches pattern ^fb-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{4,}$
Returned string is unique with extremely high probability (collision-resistant)

functions.name: FeedbackStore.__init__
functions.description: Initialize the FeedbackStore with optional configuration. Sets up in-memory indexes (empty dicts for findings and feedback). Does NOT load from disk — call load() after construction. Creates asyncio.Lock for write serialization.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Configuration for data directory and filenames. Defaults to .stigmergy/findings.jsonl and .stigmergy/feedback.jsonl.

postconditions: In-memory findings index is initialized as empty dict
In-memory feedback index is initialized as empty dict
asyncio.Lock is created for write serialization
No file I/O is performed during construction

functions.name: FeedbackStore.load
functions.description: Async method to load existing findings and feedback records from JSONL files into in-memory indexes. Reads .stigmergy/findings.jsonl and .stigmergy/feedback.jsonl. Defensive parsing: blank lines and malformed JSON lines are skipped with a warning logged. If files do not exist, indexes remain empty (no error). For feedback records, latest entry per feedback_id wins (append-only re-rating). Uses asyncio.to_thread for file I/O.

error_cases.name: io_error
error_cases.condition: Unrecoverable file I/O error (e.g., permission denied on existing file)

error_data.message: Failed to load feedback data from disk

postconditions: In-memory findings index contains all valid FindingRecord entries from findings.jsonl
In-memory feedback index contains the latest FeedbackRecord per feedback_id from feedback.jsonl
Malformed or blank lines are skipped with warnings logged, not raised as errors
If JSONL files do not exist, indexes are empty and no error is raised
side_effects: May log warnings for skipped malformed lines

functions.name: FeedbackStore.record_finding

Accepts finding metadata, creates a FindingRecord (feedback_id should already be minted via mint_feedback_id), adds it to the in-memory index, and appends the JSON-serialized record as a line to .stigmergy/findings.jsonl. Auto-creates .stigmergy/ directory on first write. Acquires asyncio.Lock for the write operation. Uses asyncio.to_thread for file I/O.

functions.name: FeedbackStore.record_feedback
functions.description: Async method to record user feedback (rating) for an existing finding. Looks up the FindingRecord by feedback_id, constructs a denormalized FeedbackRecord with the rating and current timestamp, adds/updates the in-memory feedback index, and appends the JSON-serialized record to .stigmergy/feedback.jsonl. Re-rating is allowed: a new append overwrites the in-memory entry (latest wins). Acquires asyncio.Lock for write. Uses asyncio.to_thread for file I/O.

inputs.name: feedback_id
inputs.description: The feedback_id of the finding to rate. Must exist in the findings index.

inputs.name: rating
inputs.description: The user's rating: helpful, already_knew, wrong, or irrelevant.

functions.name: FeedbackStore.list_feedback
functions.description: Async method to list FeedbackRecords from the in-memory index with optional filtering by agent_id, rating, time range, and a result limit. Returns only the latest rating per feedback_id. Results are ordered by feedback_timestamp descending (most recent first).

inputs.description: Optional filter criteria. If not provided, returns all feedback records up to default limit.

Returned list has at most 'limit' entries (or all matching if limit=0)
Returned list is ordered by feedback_timestamp descending

total_rated == helpful_count + already_knew_count + wrong_count + irrelevant_count

invariants: Every feedback_id starts with the prefix 'fb-' followed by a unique identifier
FindingRecord and FeedbackRecord are frozen (immutable) once created
FeedbackRecord is a denormalized superset of FindingRecord fields plus rating and feedback_timestamp
The in-memory index is always consistent with the on-disk JSONL files after successful writes
A FeedbackRecord can only exist for a feedback_id that has a corresponding FindingRecord
Re-rating a finding appends a new FeedbackRecord line; get_feedback returns the latest rating for a given feedback_id
Write operations are serialized via asyncio.Lock (single-process concurrency model)
Blank and malformed JSONL lines are skipped with a warning during file reads — never cause crashes
schema_version field enables future migration of stored records
content_summary is limited to 500 characters maximum
File I/O is performed via asyncio.to_thread to avoid blocking the event loop
Directory .stigmergy/ is auto-created on first write if it does not exist

.stigmergy/ directory is the data root (auto-created on first write)
